description: "Tear open the fabric of the Aurbis to summon a scion of Hermaeus Mora. This being casts forth a beam that rends asunder reality for |cffffff6|r seconds that deals |cffffff3876|r Magic Damage to enemies within 5 meters every |cffffff0.5|r seconds and snares them by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff3|r seconds. Every |cffffff0.5|r seconds, the beam's damage increases by |cffffff7|r%.\n\nThe scion's beam can be repositioned by recasting The Languid Eye."
